issues.title: Reduce wasted space in Countries List
issues.body:
In the COA form, there is some wasted space around the Countries list - particularly when the form is disabled.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132230279-f661d95e-5c3b-44fb-bcc8-5fff153ec715.png)

Could we introduce some CSS to remove the wasted components/white space for arrays when the component is disabled?

Steps to reproduce:
* play as Blue > Blue Senior
* switch to Blue COA tab
* create new COA message, including one or more countries.
* `Submit` the message
* expand the message - read-only view of countries should be shown.
